description: For a flight offer from search_trips, when the traveller asks about luggage or seats, or before book_trip if they want an extra bag: what the fare includes, the extra bags on sale (each with a choice_id, for which passenger by position, which way, its price and the most allowed), and for each flight how many seats can be chosen and their price range. To add bags, pass extras: [{ choice_id, quantity }] to book_trip; the traveller sees them ticked on the booking page and can change them. Seats are chosen by the traveller on the booking page, from the seat map, never here. Bags and seats cannot be added through Vuelo after booking. Prices are as listed now; the booking page shows the total.
name: get_flight_extras
title: Bags and seats for a flight
